finding_a1_mansion_enumeration.title: Woodland Mansion Direct Grid Enumeration Failure & Ad-Hoc Substitution
finding_a1_mansion_enumeration.discrepancy: Grid enumeration returned 0 valid structures across all 256 regions. The analysis script substituted effective_placed_structures = 1 based solely on findNearestMapStructure locating a mansion at distance 5695 blocks.
root_causes: Probe used custom hash with XOR (^) instead of Minecraft's vanilla addition (+) in RandomSpreadStructurePlacement, yielding wrong candidate chunk coordinates.
level.structureManager().getStartForStructure(...) on unloaded ChunkAccess without active structure generation worker does not populate structure starts.
Ad-hoc substitution of effective_count=1 artificially fixed density at 0.24/100km^2 based on N=1 sample without multi-seed sampling.

finding_a2_multiseed_execution.title: Multi-Seed Execution Flaw: CI Only Executed Single Seed 1002
finding_a2_multiseed_execution.discrepancy: Workflow st01-worldgen-probe.yml only ran seed 1002 (and replay 1002). Seeds 1001, 1003, 1004, 1005 were never executed in Phase 3 Minecraft server runs. Statements about 40% desert drought across seeds were carried over from Phase 2 (r=4096) rather than measured in Phase 3 (r=10240).
